items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: And the little Jap Loveless, he's there.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And the Cole Brothers Circus was playing there as a special attraction, and Miles has 15 pieces in his band. But I'm Miles' bandmaster, because Miles liked to play the drums to keep the tempo out. So I have to take over for Miles. That's Joel Morris playing there also. And the little Jap Loveless, he's there. And then is when I had to really cut it, because the bulk of the work was on me, playing all of these gallops and fast marches and sailing from one number to another, you know.
